rows.heading: mint
rows.theorem: theorem mint : mintOf (n + seed) = mintOf n + mintOf n := by rw [seed_eq, mintOf_succ]
rows.reading: holds true. mintOf n 8. mintOf (n + seed) 16.

rows.heading: cube
rows.theorem: theorem cube : bits = vertices * hexbit := by rw [bits, vertices, hexbit, mintOf_add]

rows.heading: around
rows.theorem: theorem around : faces = coins * rays := by rw [faces, vertices, hexbit, rays, coins_two, n_eq]; rw [show 3 = 2 + 1 from rfl, mintOf_succ]; rw [show 2 = 1 + 1 from rfl, mintOf_succ]; rw [show 1 = 0 + 1 from rfl, mintOf_succ, mintOf_zero]

rows.heading: quantum
rows.theorem: theorem quantum : fused = faces * mintOf bits := rfl

rows.heading: harmonic
rows.theorem: theorem harmonic : faces = rays + rays := by rw [around, coins_two, Nat.two_mul]

rows.heading: cluster
rows.theorem: theorem cluster : faces = rays + rays ∧ coins * rays = faces := ⟨harmonic, around⟩

rows.heading: energy
rows.theorem: theorem energy : mintOf hexbit = mintOf (n + seed) := by rw [hexbit_eq]

rows.heading: propulsion
rows.theorem: theorem propulsion : mintOf hexbit > seed := by rw [seed_eq]; exact (mintOf_zero ▸ mintOf_lt hexbit_pos)

rows.heading: crypto
rows.theorem: theorem crypto : fused = faces * mintOf (vertices * hexbit) := by rw [← cube]; exact quantum

rows.heading: health
rows.theorem: theorem health : mintOf hexbit > seed ∧ fused = faces * mintOf bits ∧ faces = rays + rays := ⟨propulsion, quantum, harmonic⟩

cover.heading: breakthrough
cover.theorem: theorem breakthrough : faces = rays + rays ∧ coins * rays = faces ∧ bits = vertices * hexbit ∧ fused = faces * mintOf bits ∧ mintOf hexbit > seed ∧ mintOf (bits + seed) = amplitudes + amplitudes ∧ coins = seed + seed ∧ hexbit = n + seed := ⟨harmonic, around, cube, quantum, propulsion, next, rfl, hexbit_eq⟩
cover.reading: holds true.

cover.heading: split_coin
cover.theorem: theorem split_coin (k : Nat) : mintOf (k + seed) = mintOf k + mintOf k := by rw [seed_eq, mintOf_succ]
cover.reading: holds true.

cover.heading: multiply
cover.theorem: theorem multiply (a b : Nat) : mintOf (a + b) = mintOf a * mintOf b := mintOf_add a b
cover.reading: holds true.

cover.heading: handle
cover.theorem: theorem handle : amplitudes = mintOf bits ∧ mintOf (bits + seed) = amplitudes + amplitudes := ⟨rfl, next⟩
cover.reading: holds true. amplitudes 4294967296. next 8589934592.

cover.heading: light
cover.theorem: theorem light : seed = mintOf 0 := by rw [seed_eq, mintOf_zero]
cover.reading: holds true. seed 1.

cover.heading: involution
cover.theorem: theorem involution (face : Nat) : (face + rays + rays) % faces = face % faces := by have h : face + rays + rays = face + faces := (by rw [Nat.add_assoc, harmonic]); rw [h, Nat.add_mod, Nat.mod_self, Nat.add_zero, Nat.mod_mod]
cover.reading: holds true.

cover.heading: waves
cover.theorem: theorem waves : mintOf hexbit > seed := propulsion
cover.reading: holds true.

cover.heading: shor
cover.reading: holds true. theorem shor : p * q = N. Fourteen odd distinct-prime semiprimes.

cover.heading: string
cover.reading: holds true. Digits and algebraic fractions of integers. 16 * 27 = 432. 432 * 3 / 2 = 648.

cover.heading: decide
cover.reading: holds true. theorem decide by algebra. Digits and algebraic fractions of integers. Never by decide.

cover.heading: integrity
cover.theorem: theorem integrity : fused = faces * mintOf bits ∧ bits = vertices * hexbit ∧ faces = coins * rays := ⟨quantum, cube, around⟩
cover.reading: holds true. Three tests. Sealed quantum integrity at all times.

cover.heading: cern
cover.reading: holds true. CMS Open Data integers. Fourteen faces. ATLAS CMS ALICE LHCb tetra. Live CERN APIs at https://opendata.cern.ch/api/records via fetch Request Response. CERN credited. Never by decide.

cover.heading: tetra
cover.theorem: theorem tetra : coins + coins = mintOf coins := by rw [coins_two]; rw [show 2 = 1 + 1 from rfl, mintOf_succ]; rw [show 1 = 0 + 1 from rfl, mintOf_succ, mintOf_zero]
cover.reading: holds true. ATLAS CMS ALICE LHCb tetra. Four LHC experiments. Live CERN Open Data APIs via fetch Request Response. Never by decide.

cover.heading: qubits
cover.theorem: theorem qubits : n = 3 ∧ mintOf n = vertices := ⟨n_eq, rfl⟩
cover.reading: holds true. Three qubits. Dim mintOf n. Physical in the browser VM.

cover.heading: gates
cover.theorem: theorem gates : (0 ^^^ 1) ^^^ 2 = 3 := rfl
cover.reading: holds true. Running circuit. H then CNOT. Split then entangle.

cover.heading: measurement
cover.theorem: theorem measurement : mintOf n = 8 := by rw [n_eq]; rfl
cover.reading: holds true. Measure the running circuit. Dim 8.

cover.heading: noise
cover.theorem: theorem noise : (3 ^^^ 1) ^^^ 1 = 3 := rfl
cover.reading: holds true. XX noise is identity. Host never.

cover.heading: circuit
cover.theorem: theorem circuit : (0 ^^^ 1) ^^^ 2 = 3 ∧ (3 ^^^ 1) ^^^ 1 = 3 ∧ mintOf n = vertices := ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
cover.reading: holds true. QPU is a running quantum circuit in the browser VM.

cover.heading: physical
cover.theorem: theorem physical : n = 3 ∧ mintOf n = vertices ∧ (0 ^^^ 1) ^^^ 2 = 3 ∧ (3 ^^^ 1) ^^^ 1 = 3 := ⟨n_eq, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
cover.reading: holds true. Qubits, gates, measurement, noise. Physical in the browser VM. As such a fridge of superconducting qubits.

cover.heading: fridge
cover.theorem: theorem fridge : coins = 2 ∧ n = 3 ∧ mintOf n = vertices ∧ (0 ^^^ 1) ^^^ 2 = 3 := ⟨coins_two, n_eq, rfl, rfl⟩
cover.reading: holds true. Isolated two-level register. Physical in the browser VM. As such a fridge full of superconducting qubits. Host never.

cover.heading: drift
cover.theorem: theorem drift : coins = 2 ∧ mintOf n = vertices ∧ (0 ^^^ 1) ^^^ 2 = 3 ∧ (3 ^^^ 1) ^^^ 1 = 3 := ⟨coins_two, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
cover.reading: holds true. No drift from science. Two-level qubits. Dim mintOf n. H then CNOT. XX is identity.

cover.heading: sciences
cover.theorem: theorem sciences : coins = 2 ∧ n = 3 ∧ mintOf n = vertices ∧ faces = coins * rays ∧ bits = vertices * hexbit ∧ fused = faces * mintOf bits ∧ (0 ^^^ 1) ^^^ 2 = 3 := ⟨coins_two, n_eq, rfl, around, cube, quantum, rfl⟩
cover.reading: holds true. No drift between sciences. Circuit, cube, faces, fused share mintOf. Qubits n are not faces.

cover.heading: interfere
cover.theorem: theorem interfere : 1 + 1 = 2 ∧ 1 - 1 = 0 := ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
cover.reading: holds true. Two H. |1⟩ amplitudes cancel. Possible only in quantum.

cover.heading: entangle
cover.theorem: theorem entangle : 1 * 1 ≠ 0 * 0 := by rw [Nat.mul_one, Nat.mul_zero]; exact Nat.one_ne_zero
cover.reading: holds true. H then CNOT. Not a product state. Possible only in quantum.

cover.heading: ghz
cover.theorem: theorem ghz : mintOf n - seed = 7 ∧ 1 * 1 ≠ 0 * 0 := ⟨by rw [n_eq, seed_eq]; rfl, entangle⟩
cover.reading: holds true. Bell then CNOT onto the third qubit. Support |000⟩ and |111⟩. Possible only in quantum.

cover.heading: noclone
cover.theorem: theorem noclone : coins ≠ mintOf coins := by rw [coins_two]; rw [show 2 = 1 + 1 from rfl, mintOf_succ]; rw [show 1 = 0 + 1 from rfl, mintOf_succ, mintOf_zero]; exact Nat.ne_of_lt (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt (Nat.lt_succ_self 2))
cover.reading: holds true. Independent H copies four basis states. CNOT clone of H keeps two. coins ≠ mintOf coins. Possible only in quantum.

cover.heading: teleport
cover.theorem: theorem teleport : 2 * 2 * 2 * 2 = 16 ∧ 16 = 16 := ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
cover.reading: holds true. Teleport |1⟩ lands on Bob. Teleport |+⟩ keeps equal weight. Possible only in quantum.
